decisions.reason: The ZIP, complete-folder, and v25 naming decision does not change the required legacy copy-paste behavior or workflow.
The package version and file-set instructions do not resolve or change the required naming of styles.
The source changes delivery packaging only and does not alter the table or column behavior required during paste.
Including the Master template in the v25 package does not change its bullet-size, spacing, color, or alignment requirements.
The complete v25 package instruction does not change the supported environment or cross-user stability requirement.
The source does not specify any change to Tab-based list interaction or hierarchy behavior.
The delivery-container and filename-version changes do not alter post-paste line-break behavior.
Packaging all current files as v25 does not change the prescribed style catalog or its deployment rule.
The source does not change help-label text, placement, persistence, or control-field coverage.
The v25 package instruction does not change any Danish interface text or translation coverage.
The source does not change numbered-list alignment or formatting behavior.
The package version, archive format, and required file set do not change the templates' default Word language.
